headlines.title: BofA sends strong verdict on grocer making healthy food affordable
headlines.summary: The bank’s new coverage of Natural Grocers (NGVC) points to a growth path many investors have overlooked.

headlines.title: Is Bank of America (BAC) A Bargain As New Debt Deals Test Its Valuation?
headlines.summary: Bank of America (BAC) has been active on multiple fronts in September, from preferred dividend declarations to a series of new fixed income offerings and a senior advisory hire in its Australian investment banking arm. Recent moves in Bank of America’s funding and capital structure have come against a softer tape, with a 30 day share price return of down 6.05% and a 7 day share price return of down 2.54%. headlines.title: Uber faces growing AV competition but BofA sees limited market share erosion
headlines.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has maintained its 'buy' rating and $101 price target on Uber Technologies Inc (NYSE:UBER, XETRA:UT8), saying autonomous vehicle (AV) competition will remain the main theme for the ridesharing sector.

headlines.title: Bank of America cuts UPS price target to $108 on lower package volumes
headlines.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has reiterated its 'Neutral' rating on United Parcel Service Inc (NYSE:UPS) and cut its price target to $108 from $115, citing weaker domestic package volumes and lower earnings expectations. The broker lowered its 2026 revenue estimate to $91.3 billion from $92.

headlines.title: Bank of America hikes S&P 500 target after Al trade cracks
headlines.summary: The bank raised its 2026 year-end target to 7,400 and set a 12-month goal of 7,800, closing out a losing bet against Alphabet and Meta in the process.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
